what: Oracle sells database software, business applications (NetSuite, Fusion, Cerner health records) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, which is growing fast with large AI contracts.
customers: Large companies and governments worldwide, hospitals, and AI companies renting computing capacity.
money: subscriptions and support for database and applications, OCI cloud
moat: Its database runs the core systems of many large organizations, which makes switching very costly.
risks: Very large spending on AI data centers funded by debt
Dependence on a few huge AI contracts
